about: Every option and check the Basalt learnings (issue #383) added, for tools/bench/basalt_gpu_verify.py. item: the issue's item (F<n>: Flash-Next item n, its sub-items lettered in the issue's order; X-<letter>: the cross-model items; S<n>: the serving and process items, numbered in the issue's order: S1 soak harness, S2 bench rows, S3 security, S4 /slots, S5 dashboard, S6 --config, S7 cache-affinity admission, S8 process checks). kind: identity = designed to leave the output bit for bit unchanged (its GPU tests and identity gates prove it); quality = changes numerics or the output distribution (judged by the KLD gate or by acceptance); speed = timing or scheduling only, nothing to compare bit for bit; serving = a server feature (request checks, configuration) checked against a real server. tests: a ctest regex run with tools/run-tests.ps1 -GpuOnly. identity: harness runs (ninfer_tests <test> <args>) that compare the option on against off in one process. kld: the forward harness flag for the decode-path KLD gate. ab: speed A/B variants (a and b are the arguments each arm adds to the workload); ab_reason says why an option has none.

flash-next.about: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next artifact with the MTP drafter (qwen4exp-iq2xs-mtp.ninfer), its n-gram volume beside it

qwen38-27b.about: Qwen3.8-27B DFlash2 bundle (qwen3_8_27b.ninfer, carries the MTP weights too)

fn-decode-mtp.about: Flash-Next as served from the -mtp artifact: one Engine, a warm-up prompt, then a 1,024-token chat prompt and 256 greedy tokens with MTP 3; decode tok/s of the second job

fn-prefill-2k.about: a 2,048-token prompt (the chat and doc fixtures) prefilled as one streamed call, 2 output tokens; prefill tok/s of the second job

q27-chat-greedy-dflash2.about: run_chat_decode.py: the 24 chat prompts, 512 greedy tokens each, DFlash2 with 6 drafts; decode rate from the server's own request log

q27-chat-sampled-dflash2.about: the same at temperature 0.7 (top-p 0.8, top-k 20), where relaxed drafting applies

options.summary: read one n-gram volume block after N ms idle so the drive does not sleep; the default moved from a fixed 100 ms to 40 (the one default the Basalt learnings change, stated in its commit)
options.ab_reason: the keep-alive only matters across idle gaps of more than ~100 ms on a drive that sleeps; the engine bench never idles, so it would measure nothing. Check by hand: TTFT of a request after a 1 s pause, 100 against 40.

options.summary: each MoE block's shared expert on a second CUDA stream beside the routed experts
MTP speculation for constrained requests, one grammar mask per verified position
options.ab_reason: the engine bench sends unconstrained prompts, where the option does nothing; its speed needs JSON-schema or tool-call requests through ninfer-serve, which this script does not send.

options.summary: Basalt's joint-acceptance rule chooses how many MTP drafts a round verifies
read the anchor column's n-gram rows into the host cache while the MTP draft graph runs
a default expert state shipped beside the model, read when the saved state is missing
options.ab_reason: it changes only where a fresh install's expert cache starts; the check 'default-expert-state' exports a state and starts from it.

options.summary: only the embedding's first N rows in VRAM, the rest read from pinned RAM
the GDN reads its 16 key heads in place through the tiled head map
cast each routed-expert call's input to A8 once instead of in every gate/up block
register-resident gate/up kernel with a balanced tail (needs --moe-precast-input)
route and dispatch decode-width MoE calls in one launch
compute some of each verification round's expert misses on the CPU instead of over PCIe
the CPU team size of --cpu-verify-misses and --prefill-cpu-share (default 6)
in prefill, the share F of each layer's cold experts is computed on the CPU while the GPU stages the rest
fold each verification's GDN commit on a CUDA stream of its own
int8 copies (one scale per 32 weights) of the hyper-connection mixers for calls of at most 16 columns
with --hc-int8: the MoE block's input read in one fused step (bitwise the outputs of --hc-int8 alone)
each decode round as one CUDA graph whose wait kernel holds the PLE layer until the host has read the n-gram rows
keep in host RAM only the routed experts the VRAM cache does not hold, plus spare slots
dense GGML linears of calls of at most 8 columns on the int8 tensor cores (summation order changes)
under sampling keep a draft the model gives probability P or more (CHANGES THE OUTPUT DISTRIBUTION); SamplingConfig grew from 56 to 64 bytes for it
options.kld_reason: it changes which drafts are kept under sampling, not the logits, so the KLD gate cannot see it; its A/Bs report acceptance beside speed, and the check 'relaxed-startup' starts every model with it

options.summary: ids the requests hold that the reduced draft head lacks are scored from the full head and may be drafted (drafts only)
a waiting request that resumes a prefix held on the GPU may start ahead of older waiters
options.ab_reason: a scheduling change with no single-stream speed; the check 'serve-soak' runs it under a soak with more requests than lanes and reads ninfer_admission_overtakes_total.

options.summary: Host and Origin checks (with --allowed-host NAME), the exposure warning and the constant-time key compare
options.ab_reason: a request check, no speed effect; the check 'serve-smoke' sends allowed and refused Host and Origin headers to a real server.

options.summary: ninfer-serve --config FILE with each setting's source in the startup log; the launchers' profiles became such files (S6)
options.ab_reason: startup configuration only; the checks 'serve-smoke' and 'launchers' start real servers from config files.

checks.about: the Flash-Next decode-path KLD gate at --window 1 and --window 3 must give the same rows (rows.tsv compared); it is run by the KLD phase with --kld-base-flash-next
ninfer-perplexity --kld-base on the 27B at --decode-window 1 and 3 (20 chunks), rows compared (a different route per width, so a small distance is expected)
--ggml-decode-mma per shape: ninfer_linear_ggml_test --time, the dp4a decode route against the tensor-core route at T = 1, 2, 4, 8
the served decode selects the policy: nsys over the engine bench must show ggml_mma_decode_kernel with --ggml-decode-mma and not without it
ninfer_qwen3_5_context_rows_real_test on the 27B with DFlash2 (the MTP run is in the 27B test group) and on the 35B with MTP

every option off: greedy ids of this build equal origin/master's (greedy_identity.py, two builds side by side), the 27B under DFlash2, MTP and no speculation and Flash-Next plain and MTP; SamplingConfig's 64-byte stride (X-C) changes every sampling kernel's SASS, so this is the check that it changed no output
ninfer-serve starts with --relaxed-drafting on every real model: startup refuses when the tokenizer's added ids are not contiguous
a ninfer-serve start of Flash-Next with --partial-ram-residency: whether the page-lock cap warning appears (Windows) and whether pinning succeeds
export the saved expert state with ninfer-qwen4-exp-expert-state-export, then start with no saved state and --default-expert-state: the Program must report the default state

a real 27B server from a --config file with --allowed-host: /health, /slots (array shape), /dashboard (saved for a look in a browser at desktop and phone width), /metrics (the new gauges and counters), Host and Origin refusals, the settings line
serve_soak.py's first real run (5 minutes, 4 requests in flight on one lane) on a 27B server with --admission-affinity; the overtake counter is read from /metrics
ninfer_bench --preset community-1 on the 27B: the row it prints passes check_bench_rows.py and carries the power limit

the converter and codec pytest suites (tests/convert/test_qwen4_exp.py, tests/artifact/test_ggml_codecs.py, tests/convert/test_qwen4_exp_real.py with NINFER_TEST_GGUF); skipped with a message when torch is not installed

each --iq3-pack artifact (the IQ3_XXS and IQ3_S packs): the offloaded MoE tests on its real expert banks, the forward harness on the chat fixture, an engine bench start, and the KLD gate at 20 chunks when a base is given

run.bat (Windows) or run.sh from a directory whose path has spaces and parentheses, every profile, checking the banner and the settings line; on Windows package-release.ps1 builds the archive the launcher runs from
the whole GPU suite once, after the targeted runs, without the slow tests AGENTS.md lists and without the tests the targeted runs already passed
